name: Piazza
description: The Italian-era Piazza district is Gondar's busiest hub, packed with cafes, small restaurants, shops, and budget-to-mid-range hotels. It sits within easy walking distance of Fasil Ghebbi and is the most practical base for visitors who want everything, food, transport, wifi-equipped cafes, within a short stroll. Streets are lively from early morning coffee ceremonies through evening foot traffic.
bestFor: first-time visitors, short stays, easy access to sights and cafes
pros: Most cafes and restaurants in town
cons: Noisy and dusty during the day

name: Fasil Ghebbi (Castle District)
description: The area immediately around the Fasil Ghebbi castle compound blends the UNESCO site itself with quiet residential streets, a handful of heritage-style hotels, and views over the compound walls. It is calmer than Piazza but still close enough to walk into the center. This is the spot for travelers who want to wake up near the imperial history without being in the thick of downtown traffic.
bestFor: history-focused travelers, photographers, longer cultural stays
pros: Steps from the UNESCO castle compound
cons: Fewer dining options right on site

name: Maraki (University Area)
tagline: Student energy near the University of Gondar
description: Maraki, home to the University of Gondar's main campus, has a younger, more local feel with cheaper guesthouses, student cafes, and everyday markets rather than tourist infrastructure. It sits a short bajaj ride from Piazza and offers a more authentic, lower-cost slice of city life for longer-term visitors comfortable being off the typical tourist path.
bestFor: budget-conscious long stays, immersion in local daily life
pros: Good local food stalls and markets

name: Azezo
description: Azezo is a semi-rural suburb south of central Gondar, close to Atse Tewodros Airport and along the main road toward Bahir Dar. It has a handful of guesthouses and small hotels favored by travelers arriving late or departing early, plus a quieter, more spread-out feel than downtown. It works best as a transit-friendly base rather than a cultural-immersion choice.
bestFor: early flights, late arrivals, travelers wanting distance from downtown noise
pros: Convenient for onward road travel to Bahir Dar
cons: Farther from Fasil Ghebbi and Piazza sights
